purpose: Truth-free diagnosis of the native PDC bridge failure using the same raw epoch/problem boundary as the finite no-bridge native FGO smoke.

immutable_contract.raw_clock: Phase25 frozen raw-clock-only segment/week/system rules; no derived RawPseudorangeMeters input
immutable_contract.geometry: native broadcast-nav satellite state and the same in-memory FGO problem for both paths
immutable_contract.doppler: Android rate -> RINEX D -> known satellite range-rate/clock-drift removal; receiver row is los dot velocity plus clock-rate
immutable_contract.state_units: ECEF position metres, receiver clock bias metres, ECEF velocity m/s, receiver clock rate m/s
immutable_contract.bridge: P+D+temporal state solve supplies initializer values only; no extra P/D factor or coordinate-file handoff
allowed_changes: truth-free diagnostics of raw epoch timing and problem rows
a correctness-only fix for a demonstrated physical or unit error
forbidden_changes: production default or Phase25 artifact changes

diagnostic_order: raw epoch time mapping and dt/gap/discontinuity
Doppler sign, wavelength, and m/s units
broadcast satellite position/velocity/Sagnac and satellite clock drift
receiver clock bias/rate units and adjacent-epoch relation
PDC state solve residual/cost/conditioning and quality gate

baseline_artifacts.role: truth-free finite native FGO comparison only
baseline_artifacts.bridge_artifacts: Phase25 candidate logs only; no bridge output was sealed because every recipe failed closed

predeclared_outcome.physical_fix_gate: Only a source-level sign/unit/time/state correctness defect proven by raw-only diagnostics may be changed; otherwise seal No-Go.
structural_gate_after_any_fix: all three raw routes produce finite native bridge state or fail closed with an explicit reason
Doppler row counts, units, residuals, and clock-rate states are finite and physically bounded
bridge cost is finite and non-increasing when accepted
no bridge quality gate is weakened
no truth, MAT, validation, holdout, test, sample, WLS, or precomputed trajectory is opened
predeclared_outcome.score_authorization: none in Phase26; do not open development truth even if a structural diagnostic improves
predeclared_outcome.phase25_candidate_matrix: do not rerun until all three bridge routes pass the structural gate; retain its 12/12 fail-closed result immutable

reproduction.diagnostic_input_contract: Use only the already materialized Phase25 raw/device_gnss.csv, device_imu.csv, and brdc.nav files; raw fields only.
